description: Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring - Suburb and LGA Summary - Queensland Flooding and Tropical Cyclones Tasha and Anthony, November 2010 – February 2011 is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Queensland Reconstruction Authority conducted Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring (DARMSys) audits of residences in the Brisbane, Ipswich and Central Highlands Council area following Queensland Flooding and Tropical Cyclones Tasha and Anthony, November 2010 – February 2011. The event was a heavy rainfall and associated flooding which occurred during November 2010 to February 2011. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Brisbane, Central Highlands, Floods, Housing, Ipswich. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-06-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
